te: Natural disasters and durian orchards: a request to widen the relief criteria, and preparing the blackchin tilapia seminar
se: The meeting considered the effects of natural disasters on durian orchards and farm produce, in particular improving or adding relief criteria so that farmers with damage limited to particular areas or villages can be helped, and considered a draft seminar project on the spread of the blackchin tilapia to build accurate, well-rounded understanding
it: Natural disasters affecting durian orchards and farm produce: improving relief criteria to cover damage in specific areas
Draft project and schedule for the seminar on the spread of the blackchin tilapia

te: Commercial fishing licences for sea-cucumber rakes, the Pattani deep-sea port, and the impact of foreign investment in the fruit business
se: The meeting discussed with representatives of the Department of Fisheries the issuing of commercial fishing licences for sea-cucumber rakes, including the problems and proposals for management; took note of the cooperatives subcommittee’s work on the ministerial regulation on types of cooperatives B.E. 2567; followed up the idea of a deep-sea port in Pattani and rail transport of farm products; and began studying information and law on the effects of investment by foreign operators on the fruit business in Thailand, such as fruit packing houses (lhong)
it: Commercial fishing licences for sea cucumber rakes (Director-General of Fisheries invited to give information)
Cooperatives subcommittee: the ministerial regulation on the nature, objectives and scope of business of each type of cooperative B.E. 2567
Proposals for a deep-sea port in Pattani Province and rail transport of farm products to China (Ministry of Transport, Marine Department)
Facts and law: effects of foreign operators' investment on the fruit business in Thailand

te: Beef cattle visit in Sa Kaeo, mutant rice, sea cucumber rakes and small-scale fisheries in Rayong–Chon Buri, and a reply on durian
se: The meeting took note of the work of the beef cattle subcommittee, which scheduled a visit to the Khoban Burapha project in Sa Kaeo Province on 20–21 March 2026; considered a petition from the upper Northeast about mutated rice, a letter from small-scale fisher groups in Rayong and Chon Buri concerned about issuing more licences for sea-cucumber rakes, and replies from Narathiwat Province and the Department of Agriculture
it: Integrated beef cattle subcommittee: visit to the Khobal Burapha project, Sa Kaeo Province, 20–21 March 2026
Petitions from the Senate Meets the People project, upper Northeast: mutated rice, and a request for support with rice varieties
Letter from small-scale fisher groups in Rayong and Chon Buri Provinces: concerns about the impact on resources of issuing more licences for sea-cucumber rakes
Replies from Narathiwat Province (farm inputs and outputs) and the Department of Agriculture (approaches to durian problems)

te: Preparing the blackchin tilapia forum, problems of farmers in Ratchaburi, forest reserves overlapping farmland, and the eastern fruit metropolis strategy
se: The meeting prepared a forum on the spread of the blackchin tilapia, took note of the cooperatives subcommittee’s study visit, considered petitions from Ratchaburi Province such as problems of dairy farmers, costs and debts, and African swine fever, considered proposals on eastern fruit and support for growing black gram, and a reply from the Royal Forest Department on national forest reserve boundaries overlapping communities
it: Preparing a forum on the spread of the blackchin tilapia
Cooperatives subcommittee: summary of the study visit, 12–13 February 2026
Petitions from the Senate Meets the People project, lower Central region, Ratchaburi Province: dairy farmers, costs and debts, African swine fever, and pork imports
A natural gas power plant project in Chachoengsao Province
Request for budget support for a village-level farming project (black gram) as a second source of income
Proposal to push the eastern “fruit metropolis” strategy
Letter from the Royal Forest Department: the Khun Song national forest reserve boundary overlapping communities, temples, schools and farmland

te: Using the blackchin tilapia, a matter from residents of Satun, and an adviser appointed
se: The Committee invited representatives of the Thai Aquaculture Federation to provide information on innovative uses of the blackchin tilapia, which is hard to eliminate completely and so could become an economic opportunity alongside control measures. The meeting considered petitions from Satun Province and appointed honorary advisers and a secretary to the Committee
it: Blackchin tilapia: the Thai Aquaculture Federation provided information on innovative uses, turning a crisis into an economic opportunity
Grievances from the Senate Meets the People project, lower south, Satun Province
Honorary advisers and committee secretary appointed

te: Joining a working group on coconut prices, summary of the food industry visit, matters from Samut Sakhon residents, and preparing the New Zealand visit
se: The meeting assigned members to represent it in the working group on low coconut prices of the Senate Committee on Commerce and Industry, summarised the agro-industry and food study visit in Saraburi and Nakhon Ratchasima, considered petitions from Samut Sakhon Province such as fisheries law and disease in snakeskin gourami and registering aromatic coconuts, and followed up preparations for the visit to New Zealand on 9–15 March 2026
it: Members assigned to a working group on low coconut prices under the Senate Committee on Commerce and Industry
Summary of the visit on agro-industry, food and value-adding agriculture, Saraburi and Nakhon Ratchasima Provinces, 22–24 January 2026
Petitions from the Senate Meets the People project, lower Central region, Samut Sakhon Province: fisheries law and disease in snakeskin gourami, registering aromatic coconuts, and sediment problems
Preparing the bilateral meetings and visit to New Zealand, 9–15 March 2026 (fiscal year 2026)

te: Tax on hazardous farm chemicals, Kanchanaburi farming proposals, and summary of the Khon Kaen–Chaiyaphum drought water visit
se: The subcommittees reported progress, including on farmer debt and a study of taxing hazardous agricultural chemicals based on examples from other countries. The meeting considered explanatory letters from agencies on proposals to solve farming problems in Kanchanaburi Province and agreed to send the proposals to the Office of the Prime Minister for review, and summarised the study visit on water management for drought in Khon Kaen and Chaiyaphum
it: Food Security Subcommittee: taxing hazardous agricultural chemicals (examples from Denmark, Sweden, Norway and France)
Letter from agencies of the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives on proposals to develop farming and solve farm problems in Kanchanaburi Province
Following up implementation of the resolutions of the 46th General Assembly of the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Assembly
Summary of the visit on water management for drought and floods, Khon Kaen and Chaiyaphum Provinces, 15–16 January 2026

te: Observations from the Hat Yai flood seminar, the draft Rice and Rice Farmers Act, durian problems in Chumphon, and the Khon Kaen–Chaiyaphum water visit
se: The meeting summarised observations from a seminar on the Hat Yai floods, such as early evacuation warning systems, took note of the cooperatives subcommittee’s work on scammers misusing information to deceive farmers, considered a letter from a farmers’ network proposing a draft National Rice and Rice Farmers Act, followed up approaches to low durian and fruit prices in Chumphon, and scheduled a study visit on water management in Khon Kaen and Chaiyaphum
it: Observations from a seminar on the Hat Yai floods (14 January 2026): warning systems and early evacuation
Cooperatives subcommittee: scammers misusing Farmers' Welfare Fund information to deceive farmers
Letter from a farmers' network asking for consideration of the draft National Rice and Rice Farmers Act B.E. ....
Progress on ways to address low prices and high costs of durian and other fruit for large-scale farm groups in Chumphon Province (Department of Agriculture: GAP standard)
Study visit on agriculture, livestock and water management, Khon Kaen and Chaiyaphum Provinces, 15–16 January 2026

te: Blackchin tilapia, the draft 1-year work report, and raw milk problems of dairy farmers in Lop Buri
se: The meeting discussed the study of the spread of the blackchin tilapia, informed by the Department of Fisheries, the Land Development Department and others concerned, considered the draft 1-year performance report (2025) and explanatory letters from agencies. On dairy farmers in Lop Buri Province having to discard raw milk, the meeting agreed to write to the Department of Livestock Development and the Dairy Farming Promotion Organization of Thailand (D.P.O.) asking for the facts
it: The spread of the blackchin tilapia: discussing a summary of the study after hearing from the Department of Fisheries, the Land Development Department and others concerned
Draft report on the committee's work over 1 year (1 January–31 December 2025)
Letter from the Office of the Permanent Secretary for Agriculture and Cooperatives on supporting operators in contract farming
Trang Province reports progress on building the fishing pier bridge in Tase Subdistrict, Hat Samran District
Dairy farmers in Lop Buri had to pour away more than 40 tonnes of raw milk when it was not bought

te: Starting the 2026 work: planning the whole year, preparing a food industry visit in Saraburi–Nakhon Ratchasima, and matters from residents of the lower North
se: At the first meeting of 2026, the meeting considered the year’s work plan in line with the national strategy on value-creating agriculture and the strategy of the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives, scheduled a study visit on agro-industry and food in Saraburi and Nakhon Ratchasima Provinces on 22–24 January 2026, considered petitions from the Senate Meets the People project, and followed up progress from agencies, such as an approach to buying crude palm oil for power generation
it: The Committee’s work plan for 2026 (national strategy on value-creating agriculture, the 20-year strategy of the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives)
Study visit on agro-industry, food and value-adding agriculture, Saraburi and Nakhon Ratchasima Provinces, 22–24 January 2026
Petitions from the Senate Meets the People project, lower North (Sukhothai, Uttaradit, Tak): shortage of water for household use, and standing floodwater on farmland
Progress from agencies: the Ministry of Energy reports on buying crude palm oil for power generation

te: Summary of the Chumphon study visit: a model for grouping fattened-cattle farmers
se: The meeting summarised the study visit to Chumphon Province on 21–22 April 2026, which learned from a community enterprise of fattened-cattle farmers that has worked together since 2020 to strengthen its bargaining power. It works as a network of more than 30 farms under shared agreements on rearing standards, collection and sales, and gives priority to breed improvement. The visit also studied industrial-scale beef processing
it: Summary of the study visit on standard cattle rearing and integrated beef processing, Chumphon Province

te: Preparing a study visit on standard cattle rearing and integrated processing in Chumphon
se: The meeting prepared the study visit on standard cattle rearing and integrated beef processing in Chumphon Province, which will study group management and cattle fattening by a community enterprise in Pathio District, and the industrial beef production of an operator in Tha Sae District
it: Preparations for the study visit to Chumphon Province

te: Views of 7 ministries heard on the policy proposals on beef cattle
se: The meeting considered policy recommendations and heard the views of agencies from 7 ministries. For example, the Ministry of Finance explained low-interest credit through state banks, credit guarantees and tax measures to support SME operators. The subcommittee made further observations so that the measures actually reach cattle farmers
it: Policy recommendations on beef cattle breed improvement and marketing

te: Summary of the Sa Kaeo study visit: hearing the debt problems of cattle farmers in the Khobal Burapha project
se: The meeting considered the summary of the study visit to Sa Kaeo Province on 20–21 March 2026, which heard the debt problems of cattle farmers in the "Khobal Burapha" project that began in 2017. The meeting noted that the problems have several sides, such as the readiness of the animal breeds, the readiness of farmers and the cooperative system, and drought affecting animal feed, and it discussed proposed solutions
it: Summary of the study visit on the debt problems of cattle farmers, Sa Kaeo Province, 20–21 March 2026

te: Proposals on beef processing and marketing added to the draft report
se: The meeting considered the report on "Breed Improvement and Integrated Beef Cattle Marketing Strategy Development to Increase Competitiveness" and added proposals on processing, such as upgrading slaughterhouses and community butchers to GMP, HACCP and halal standards, low-interest credit, a national meat grading system, product labels and traceability, and applying the BCG concept to by-products. It also added marketing proposals for the state to help stabilise prices and increase farmers' bargaining power
it: Study report on Breed Improvement and Integrated Beef Cattle Marketing Strategy Development to Increase Competitiveness: processing and marketing

te: Setting an approach to managing the whole beef cattle industry in an integrated way
se: The meeting considered the management of the beef cattle industry as a whole, from production and processing to marketing. It found that the main problems are information systems, oversight mechanisms and laws that are not yet linked together. It therefore felt that the whole system should be integrated from upstream to downstream, under a clear policy and using data to support decisions, starting with developing genetics that meet market demand
it: Approach to managing the beef cattle industry in an integrated way
